newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bloodstained Israeli taxi found empty in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Bloodstained Israeli taxi found empty in West Bank.

text.p: The car of a missing Israeli taxi driver has been found abandoned and bloodstained in the Palestinian-ruled town of Jericho, police said on Friday.

An Israeli police spokeswoman said Israeli and Palestinian police had mounted a joint search for the 45-year-old driver, who disappeared on Thursday night on his way from Jerusalem to pick up a passenger at a Jewish settlement on the West Bank.
"The taxi was found in...Jericho without the driver and with bloodstains," the spokeswoman said. She had no further details.
An Israeli Army spokeswoman said Jericho, which Israel handed over to Palestinian self-rule under interim peace deals, was no longer sealed off as it had been immediately after the car was found.

Israel Channel Two Television said there were signs of a struggle in the vehicle, which had blood streaks on its exterior and was discovered in a wadi. Searches for the driver had been suspended until daylight on Saturday, Israel radio reported.
Israeli-Palestinian tension has run high since a double suicide bombing killed 16 people, including the attackers, at a market in Jerusalem on July 30.
Israel has imposed a closure on the West Bank and Gaza Strip, barring tens of thousands of Palestinians from entering the Jewish state.
